title: Arrive and ease into Chania
summary: Settle in, then let the old harbour make the first impression.
tip: Keep dinner flexible in case the flight runs late.

activities.title: Land at Chania Airport
activities.note: Collect the car and pick up water before driving into town.
Check in first, then wander without a route toward the water.
Share a relaxed first dinner after the harbour walk.

title: Balos blues
summary: An early start for the lagoon, followed by a long village lunch.
tip: Pack sturdy shoes; the path down is rocky and exposed.

activities.note: Explore both sides of the lagoon, then find shade before hiking back.
Refuel slowly before the drive back to Chania.

title: Gardens and mountain roads
summary: A cooler, greener day with space for a long lunch.
tip: Mountain temperatures drop quickly after sunset; bring a light layer.

activities.note: Wind back through the gorge with a short coffee stop in the village.

title: A completely open day
summary: No checklist—follow the weather, energy, and appetite.
tip: Good fallback: Nea Chora beach and a seafood lunch close to town.

title: Elafonisi, quietly
summary: A softer alternative to the main beach, with time to linger.
tip: There are few facilities at Kedrodasos; carry water and leave no trace.

activities.note: Walk beyond the first cove for quieter water and shade under the junipers.

activities.title: Slow return to Chania
activities.note: Pause for coffee and mountain views rather than racing back.

title: Falassarna sunset
summary: A lazy start, a broad beach, and dinner after sundown.
tip: Stay ten minutes after sunset—the colour often gets better.

activities.note: Choose a quieter stretch north of the main beach and settle in for sunset.

title: One last harbour morning
summary: Coffee, sea air, and an easy goodbye.
tip: Fuel the car before entering the airport approach road.

activities.note: A final unhurried loop along the water before checking out.

activities.title: Drive to the airport
activities.note: Return the car and allow comfortable time for bag drop.
